chunks: Ishaq ibn 'Ammar asked Abā Ibrāhīm عليه السلام:
About a man who forgot to trim his nails at the time of ihram until he had entered ihram. He عليه السلام said: “He should leave them.”
I said: “One of our companions gave him the ruling to trim his nails and repeat his ihram, and so he did.” Then he عليه السلام said: “A blood-sacrifice is upon him.”

key_terms.الْإِحْرَامِ: the state of consecration for hajj or 'umrah
key_terms.يَدَعُهَا: he should leave them as they are

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone forgets to trim his nails before entering ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a muhrim who forgot to trim his nails before entering ihram. The Imam عليه السلام instructs that once ihram has begun, he should leave them as they are; if he trims them after entering ihram, he incurs the penalty of a sacrificial offering.
